domain_title: Data, privacy, confidentiality and intellectual property
title: Intellectual property, licensing and content rights
canonical_definition: The organization has a defensible and traceable basis to use, transform, train on, retrieve, generate and distribute relevant data, models, code and outputs.

conditions: When third-party, customer, employee, open-source or generated content is used or distributed.
Record the assessed release, operating scope and evidence that supports any applicability decision.

primary_questions.question: Are rights, licences, restrictions, attribution and ownership conditions identified for all material assets and outputs?
Are those conditions implemented in ingestion, training, retrieval, generation, review and distribution workflows?
Does current evidence demonstrate compliance with restrictions and effective detection or review of infringement risk?

capability_indicators: Restricted content is blocked or permissioned

conditions: Refer a material failure of intellectual property, licensing and content rights to the accountable authority before a consequential transition.

normative_source_mappings.relevant_locator: NIST AI 100-1, GOVERN 1.1 (PDF p. 27), GOVERN 6.1 (PDF p. 29), MAP 4.1 (PDF p. 32)
normative_source_mappings.mapping_rationale: The voluntary framework provides guidance on identifying legal requirements and third-party intellectual-property risk. The SAE criteria define the object-specific rules. Confirm any binding obligation through the accountable authority and its applicable source.

governance_purpose: Make intellectual property, licensing and content rights verifiable against the current AI system, decision context and accountable ownership.
distinct_claim: B5 evaluates intellectual property, licensing and content rights using evidence from intent through operation. AP-B5 independently assesses evidence of unverified rights and output ownership.

atomic_subcriteria.criterion: The versioned definition identifies an asset and output rights register identifying ownership, relevant licenses, restrictions, permitted uses, attribution and review authority. Record the accountable owner, scope and material assumptions.

The current release demonstrates rights gates for acquisition, training, retrieval and distribution with restricted items handled according to their evidenced permissions. Trace the decisions and controls to attributable records.

Representative, executed evidence provides version-bound asset and output samples tracing permission to actual use and documenting unresolved review exceptions. Compare expected and observed outcomes and record exceptions.
For an operating system, current records cover the material paths involved in intellectual property, licensing and content rights, including relevant exceptions and changes.

required_evidence.title: Versioned scope and control definition
required_evidence.description: Provide an asset and output rights register identifying ownership, relevant licenses, restrictions, permitted uses, attribution and review authority. Include the affected workflow, current version and accountable owner.

required_evidence.title: Effective implementation records
required_evidence.description: Demonstrate rights gates for acquisition, training, retrieval and distribution with restricted items handled according to their evidenced permissions. Trace the scope, control and authority to the current implementation, including exceptions.

required_evidence.title: Representative verification results
required_evidence.description: Provide version-bound asset and output samples tracing permission to actual use and documenting unresolved review exceptions. Include current version, test scope, criteria, expected and observed outcomes, and unresolved failures.

required_evidence.title: Current operating or change evidence
required_evidence.description: Retain dated records that show how intellectual property, licensing and content rights works for the assessed scope, including the relevant exceptions and any material change since the evidence was captured.

sufficiency: Start with an asset and output rights register identifying ownership, relevant licenses, restrictions, permitted uses, attribution and review authority. Reconcile it against the effective controls and representative results for the same operating scope and version.

Use version-bound asset and output samples tracing permission to actual use and documenting unresolved review exceptions to support effectiveness at the relevant lifecycle stage. Record missing paths and unresolved conflicts as UNKNOWN. A verified shortfall can support a gap without resolving the other questions.
Reassess affected evidence after a material change. An accountable human validates or approves the result where required by the lifecycle target.
evidence_rules.evidence_ceiling: A specification supports DECLARED intent. Effective implementation records may support IMPLEMENTED. Representative executed tests support TESTED within their scope. Current operating evidence supports OPERATIONALLY_OBSERVED for covered paths and time. Record human assurance independently.
false_positive_guards: A verified license or exception can support limited use within its actual terms and scope.
Reconcile document claims with the effective release, actual operation and relevant exceptions before recording satisfaction.
prohibited_inferences: A capability gap alone cannot establish AP-B5 presence.
An approved design or evidence plan cannot establish test execution or operational effectiveness.
Satisfying this capability cannot by itself authorize progression or establish legal compliance.

finding_definitions.title: Material definition or intent gap in intellectual property, licensing and content rights
Verified implementation or effectiveness gap in intellectual property, licensing and content rights
Evidence remains insufficient for intellectual property, licensing and content rights in the assessed scope
